findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "eyJrIjoiY29ubmVjdG9yIiwiaSI6ImNvbl9tY3BfcmVnaXN0cnlfZXNxIiwicCI6Im1jcC1yZWdpc3RyeSJ9.3b61cb285412dd02ba328c4c5ccd0b00" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_search_filters, search_attorneys, get_attorney_profile, get_contact_request_status, get_matching_requirements, find_attorneys, get_introduction_status, get_referral_status · Private data: start_from_directory_profile, preview_client_message, search_attorneys, get_attorney_profile, send_client_message, get_contact_request_status, cancel_contact_request, update_listing_criteria, report_listing_error, prepare_introduction, find_attorneys, request_attorney_introduction, update_matching_preferences, get_introduction_status, get_referral_status · Public sink: send_client_message, submit_listing_feedback, submit_matching_feedback · Destructive: start_from_directory_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_search_filters, search_attorneys, get_attorney_profile, get_contact_request_status, get_matching_requirements, find_attorneys, get_introduction_status, get_referral_status · Private data: start_from_directory_profile, preview_client_message, search_attorneys, get_attorney_profile, send_client_message, get_contact_request_status, cancel_contact_request, update_listing_criteria, report_listing_error, prepare_introduction, find_attorneys, request_attorney_introduction, update_matching_preferences, get_introduction_status, get_referral_status · Public sink: send_client_message, submit_listing_feedback, submit_matching_feedback · Destructive: start_from_directory_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
